# Cesur Polat

> Cesur Polat is a full-stack developer in Sakarya, Türkiye, specializing in .NET, Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, APIs, and modern, scalable web apps.

Cesur Polat develops modern, scalable web applications using ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL Server, and related technologies.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://cesurpolat.dev/): Overview of Cesur Polat, technical expertise, experience, and featured projects.

## Featured Projects

- [Termoware](https://primeware.com.tr/urunler): Enterprise web-based HVAC engineering platform for equipment selection, sizing, performance calculations, and project management, built with ASP.NET Core, Angular, SQL Server, and gRPC.
- [VectorMark](https://github.com/CesurPolat/VectorMark): Local-first AI-powered bookmark manager that automatically organizes and retrieves bookmarks using semantic search, local embeddings, and vector similarity. Built as a privacy-first Chrome extension with VecLite, IndexedDB, and HNSW indexing.
- [MiBudsClient](https://github.com/CesurPolat/MiBudsClient): Open-source desktop application for Redmi Buds 6 Play, providing real-time battery monitoring, Bluetooth device management, low-latency mode control, and automatic device detection. Built with Python and Flet.
